main_text.head: CAP. XXVIII.

head.i: Utrum duella licentiâ superiorum inter socios aut subditos suscepta, sint licita ?

main_text.p: PTacit. Hi-stor,l 4.roclivius est, teste Annalium scriptore, injuria, quam beneficio vicem exolvere: quia gratia oneri, ultio in quæstu habetur. Quæ causa est, ut ex minimis jurgiis, injuria quavis verbali, duella, & hinc homicidia oriantur. Nec tantum potuere leges, aut edicta, ut non prævaluerint vitia, ac depravati hominum mores, quibus ad injuriarum illatarum vindicationem per congressum singularem incitantur. Qua ratione factum, ut necessarium quondam fuerit duella inter subditos permittere, si quando justæ eorum probarentur causæ. Unde limites ponebantur illimalo in-ve-

page.notes: The first letter P is a large initial, joined to the word as "Proclivius". The hyphenated word "in-ve-" runs over the page end and continues on the next page. "illimalo" is printed as it stands and may be a printing error for "illimato". Some letters in the margin note are faint.
